Glad you got it working. I saved a note to the project's memory: newer wkhtmltopdf versions need `--enable-local-file-access` or the invoice PDF tests fail. That way the next session won't have to track down the same failure.

You said you fixed it locally. If that's only a local config change, consider adding the flag where the repo calls wkhtmltopdf too. Otherwise CI and other developers on newer versions will hit the same failure.
